name: save-boot-20a-world-save-circle
description: #226 attempt 3: an in-game save from the world map. Load disc1-wm1-kalm (Circle every 30 frames until g_GameState 3), close the entry message window as save-boot-7-world-kalm does (600 frames, three Circle presses a second apart, then wait for window 0 to read 0), 60 frames, press Triangle every 60 frames until the world loop state reads 2 (menu_wait), then no input until g_GameState reads 5 (the menu module; gs_wait, up to 1200 frames), 60 frames, move the main-menu cursor to Save (row 9) with the menu planner (one Up: the menu wraps), then Circle 8 times, 90 frames apart (Save, the first card, the first file, then any prompt's default), and 120 frames still. The card check compares the slot 1 card at the end with the card at the start: card_ok 1 when a slot changed and the first changed one holds a save with a right checksum and module 3 (world map). c_n: slots changed; c_slot: the first; c_sum: 1 if its checksum is right; c_mod: its savemap module (the location is not reported: 8-metric limit). match: a rerun from the same snapshot. Only numbers leave.
